title: Expose directory switching to plugins
body: The built-in agent can switch a conversation's working directory, but plugins have no supported API for it. Sending PATCH /conversations/id with a directory field returns 400 unknown field. Please add a plugin SDK method conversations.update({directory}) so plugins can do this without launching an agent turn.

title: Preview remains visible after the host reloads
body: Widget desktop 1.2 on macOS 15. I observed the previous project's preview floating above the next workspace after a switch. Expected: the preview is hidden when the host reloads. Candidate steps: open the embedded preview, then call window.location.reload() from the main window console and inspect whether the old native view remains visible before the new UI mounts. These minimal steps have not been independently tested end to end; the original observation happened while also changing the saved layout.
